profile.headline: Senior Lead Development Engineer | Enterprise Web at Scale | Engineering Leadership
profile.summary: Senior engineer with 10+ years building enterprise consumer web products at scale. Currently embedded with a major U.S. telecom carrier as a Senior Lead Development Engineer — working across payments, billing, and account management serving 120M+ subscribers. Experienced leading feature development, mentoring engineers, and driving cross-team delivery. Passionate about engineering leadership, team development, and delivering complex products at scale.

positions.title: Senior Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Lead developer embedded with a major U.S. telecom carrier, driving feature development across consumer web products including payments, billing, account management, international roaming, and phone shopping, serving 120M+ subscribers.
- Onboarded and mentored 10+ engineers onto a large-scale enterprise codebase, accelerating team ramp-up and providing ongoing technical guidance.
- Served as cross-team lead representative, coordinating across engineering teams to drive feature delivery and resolve dependencies on shared platform work.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​
positions.insights: Skills: Engineering Management · Agile Methodologies · Technical mentoring · Software Architecture · Team Leadership · Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) · Svelte · Astro

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description: Software consulting firm building enterprise healthcare solutions. Developed Angular and Java microservice applications for major health insurance carriers including insurance provider portals, seller management platforms, and clinician search tools.

positions.title: VR Developer
positions.description: Virtual reality and web consulting start-up. Consulted for various technology companies, including Microsoft, to help one of their R&D teams tackle the new VR development environment. Currently, we are building a Samsung GearVR game that will support the new GearVR controller.

volunteerExperiences.description: I love teaching and working with youth. I was able to coach youth baseball and help the players develop life skills both on and off the field.
